verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API for managing agents, but probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the standard paths. The closest thing to a machine-readable spec is the CLI's "live self-describing contract" plus an llms.txt overview, which are only partial substitutes. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for the REST API, documentation of where such a spec lives, and independent confirmation that the CLI contract covers the full API surface.
